summary: Executed targeted backend+frontend regression for Water metric unit edit. Verified Edit Metric now persists quantity_unit=KiloLitres and reopens with KiloLitres displayed; numeric quantity remained unchanged. Restored original unit after verification. Verified Add Metric still retains selected unit.

issues: Console repeatedly logs chart container width/height -1 warnings
Console shows React key-spread warning in chart components

action_items: Address dashboard chart sizing warnings (width/height -1) to reduce runtime noise
Fix React key prop spread warning in chart rendering code
Add data-testid attributes for Edit Metric modal controls (edit/save/unit select) to improve automation stability
critical_code_review_comments: ESGRecordsDataEntry Edit Metric flow still lacks data-testid on interactive elements (edit icon, unit selectors, save/discard), reducing deterministic testability and increasing selector fragility.
Frontend runtime has repeated console warnings/errors in dashboard rendering (chart sizing + key spread), indicating avoidable rendering issues that can mask real regressions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Water KPI route is /environment/water. Reliable nav testids: sidebar-environment -> sidebar-environment.water -> sidebar-environment.water.kpi. Edit modal unit combobox was the 5th combobox in tested record and persisted KiloLitres correctly. Add Metric tab testid: esg-tab-add-metric.
rca of the issue: Original bug was due to missing unitValue/onUnitChange wiring in Edit Metric DynamicFieldRenderer. After wiring, selecting KiloLitres correctly updates field_values.<field_key>_unit and backend persists it unchanged. Regression test confirmed persistence on reopen/reload and no numeric value drift.
